items.quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 17.12.2024, sent by ordinary post by a tax office (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting = Fri 20.12.2024 (not a weekend/holiday, so it stands). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) begins the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 108 Abs. 1 AO), i.e. on 21.12.2024, and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Mon 20.01.2025. That day is a normal business day (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 108 Abs. 3 AO).
